description: Search the Crela marketplace for approved software, apps and games. Public, no API key required. Returns only approved, publicly listed tools — use list_my_software to see your own pending/rejected/unlisted tools. Use limit (1-50) to control how many results come through and keep the response small; page through the rest with page.

lang.description: Filter by the language of the software user interface, e.g. "de". Not the programming language.

limit.description: How many results come through, 1-50 (server default 20). Lower it to a short shortlist to keep the response small; then get_software for the full detail of one.

page.description: 1-based page for paging through more results (see total_pages in the response) instead of pulling everything at once

query.description: Full-text search over title and description

name: search_software
title: Search Crela software
